scope: speak/voice cite cleanup gate threshold tune (inference-only, $0 mac-local)

spec_provenance.source_rule_text: TLM tension >0.7 → cite verbose mode / <0.3 → cite minimal mode

gate_definition.input_signal: tension scalar in [0.0, 1.0] from TLM hidden-state projection (Phase 3-mini placeholder = direct 5-channel WHY-axis read; full TLM head deferred to cond.2 IMPL)

decision_rule_default_pre_tune.rule: tension > high → verbose; tension < low → minimal; otherwise → default

gate_definition.downstream_consumer: anima-voice/ + handoff doc generators (cite verbosity = how much source-of-truth + line-number breadcrumb a generated doc emits)
gate_definition.fallback_invariant: cond.6a fails closed to mode=default — TLM-independent path retained per tlm_phase3_spec §2.4 'graceful degradation'

validation_set.source: anima-voice in-tree tension samples + emotion_prosody.hexa rule corners + anima_speak_voice_cite_cleanup audit narrative cases

samples.rationale: near-zero tension, no urgency, minimal cite OK
low arousal sad state, terse cite preferred
whisper corner — minimal mode aligned with prosody intent
boundary case just above low_threshold; rule-based prosody = interrogative
exclamatory corner — boundary case (see C1 caveat)
high tension declaration, verbose cite required

validation_set.label_provenance: expected_mode labels derived from anima-voice prosody intent + cite-cleanup cycle audit residual cite policy (immutable corpus PRESERVE = high tension verbose analogue / clean rename = low tension minimal analogue)

boundary_alignment.exclamatory_corner_V10: PASS (0.61 < 0.70 → default — exclamatory ≠ verbose; see C1)

tuning_grid_evaluated.rationale: tighter — only extreme tension triggers mode change, more default-mode coverage
tuning_grid_evaluated.deviation: V4 whisper corner 0.19 < 0.20 → minimal (still PASS), but V5 0.31 → default OK; sample V4 still PASS but V9 (0.80) becomes boundary — verbose vs default ambiguous; counted as PASS by 'tension >= high → verbose' interpretation

tuning_grid_evaluated.rationale: looser — more samples flip to verbose/minimal, fewer in default band
tuning_grid_evaluated.deviation: V5 (0.31 < 0.40 → minimal, but expected default), V8 (0.69 > 0.60 → verbose, but expected default), V10 (0.61 > 0.60 → verbose, but expected default — exclamatory corner conflict)

tuning_grid_evaluated.rationale: align with anima-voice/emotion_prosody.hexa rule constants exactly (whisper < 0.20, exclamatory > 0.60)
tuning_grid_evaluated.deviation: V8 (0.69 > 0.60 → verbose, expected default), V10 (0.61 > 0.60 → verbose, expected default — see C1)

tuning_grid_evaluated.rationale: asymmetric — keep low at spec default, raise high to suppress verbose-overuse
tuning_grid_evaluated.deviation: ties T_default at 1.0 — see §verdict on tie-breaker

selection_rationale: T_default and T_asymmetric_high both achieve 12/12 (100%) agreement on the 12-sample set
tie-breaker = principle of minimal departure from frozen spec (tlm_phase3_spec §2.4 line 122) — T_default matches verbatim
T_asymmetric_high (0.75/0.30) is reserved as fallback IF future expanded validation set shows verbose-overfire on the 0.70-0.75 band
0.70/0.30 also matches the dominant default in sister LM threshold conventions (sibling LM cross-substrate consistency carried forward from TLM stage12 land §1)
rejected T_loose (75%) — 3 boundary samples flip incorrectly
rejected T_prosody_aligned (83.3%) — exclamatory corner V10/V8 over-trigger verbose
rejected T_tight (91.7%) — 1 boundary sample marginal (T_default strictly dominates)
verdict.boundary_band_low: [0.30, 0.40] = default-mode floor; samples with tension in this band emit default cite cadence
verdict.boundary_band_high: [0.60, 0.70] = default-mode ceiling; samples in this band emit default cadence (NOT verbose), preventing exclamatory-corner over-fire
verdict.hysteresis_recommendation: for time-series tension trajectories, recommend ±0.05 hysteresis around each threshold to suppress mode-thrash near boundaries (deferred to Phase 3 cond.6a IMPL — out of scope for this $0 spec-tune cycle)

fallback_policy.tension_signal_clipped: tension clipped to [0.0, 1.0] before threshold compare
fallback_policy.phase3_mini_provisional_source: cond.6a inference-only — tension scalar may be sourced from existing 5-channel encoder pre-LM-head OR from .roadmap.tensionlink wire UDP capture (placeholder, both equivalent for threshold tune)

honest_caveats: C1 — exclamatory-corner conflict: emotion_prosody.hexa rule says tension > 0.6 + arousal > 0.7 = exclamatory utterance, intuitively a 'loud declaration' that might suggest verbose cite. T_default rule (high=0.70) puts tension=0.61-0.69 in default band, NOT verbose. Validation labels this PASS because cite verbosity ≠ utterance loudness (verbose cite = SOURCE-OF-TRUTH emit, NOT prosody amplitude). C1 risk = downstream consumer surprise if prosody-amplitude semantics confused with cite-volume semantics.

C2 — sample size 12 is small + label provenance is heuristic (derived from prosody intent + cite-cleanup audit narrative, NOT from real cite-emission ground truth). True validation requires logged cite-emission events from anima-voice production runtime + tension-tagged user feedback. Current 12/12 PASS is a spec-self-consistency check, NOT a downstream-utility measurement.

C3 — TLM Phase 3 cond.2 (LM head) status = partial (spec frozen, IMPL/training 0건 per .roadmap.tlm_tension_lm cond.2). cond.6a tension scalar source is currently a placeholder (5-channel WHY-axis direct read OR .roadmap.tensionlink wire), NOT a TLM head output. True cond.6 land requires cond.2 IMPL + a real TLM hidden-state projection layer. Phase 3-mini cond.6a captures the threshold rule + validation methodology only, leaving the upstream signal-source to Phase 3 cond.2 IMPL (deferred per $200 cap).
